note.moved: Nothing has moved yet: no data has been collected, so every KPI below shows no value.
note.why: Our usage tracker is built and tested but not live (it needs a Supabase project and a push to the live site), and the daily collection rota has not started.

kpis.name: Reach per week on Instagram and TikTok
kpis.counted: Accounts reached in the last 7 days, Instagram plus TikTok, read from each platform's Insights screenshot.
kpis.decision: Not a KPI. It explains changes in site visits: if reach rises but visits don't, the posts aren't sending people to the site.

kpis.name: Site visits per week
kpis.counted: Distinct visitor IDs with a page view in the 7 days up to this date, team browsers excluded.
kpis.decision: Where we spend posting and outreach time. A source that sends nobody for two weeks gets cut.
kpis.source: QUERIES.md Q1 (Supabase events), saved as data/YYYY-MM-DD-tracker-q1.csv; checked against data/YYYY-MM-DD-cloudflare.png

kpis.name: Sign-ups and bookings per week
kpis.counted: Get Started intakes sent successfully (sign_up) plus mock-interview bookings (booking_created) in the 7 days up to this date.
kpis.decision: If visits rise but sign-ups stay flat, we fix the Get Started page, not the posts.
kpis.source: QUERIES.md Q2, saved as data/YYYY-MM-DD-tracker-q2.csv; checked against data/YYYY-MM-DD-hand.txt (Gmail and Cal.com counts)

kpis.name: Activation rate
kpis.window: new visitors in the 7 days ending 7 days before this date
kpis.counted: Share of new visitors who got AI resume feedback, built a roadmap or got an AI coach answer within 7 days of their first visit.
kpis.decision: If it is low, the home page sends new students straight into one tool instead of showing them everything.

kpis.name: Weekly active users
kpis.counted: Distinct visitor IDs that did at least one tool action (not just a page view) in the 7 days up to this date.
kpis.decision: Read together with actions per active user: if users grow while actions per user fall, students are drifting away.

kpis.name: Actions per active user per week
kpis.counted: Tool actions in the 7 days up to this date, divided by weekly active users. Our version of Peloton's workouts per subscription.
kpis.decision: If it falls two weeks in a row, we pause new promotion and fix the tools students are leaving.

kpis.name: Still active after 1 week
kpis.window: latest cohort whose week-1 window has closed
kpis.counted: Of the visitors who signed up or did a main action in a week, the share who did a tool action again 7 to 13 days later.
kpis.decision: If it is near zero, more promotion only fills a leaky bucket, so we fix the product first.

kpis.name: Still active after 4 weeks
kpis.window: latest cohort whose week-4 window has closed
kpis.counted: Of the visitors who signed up or did a main action in a week, the share who did a tool action again 28 to 34 days later.
kpis.decision: Decides whether the rest of the semester goes on getting new students or keeping the ones we have.

funnel.source: QUERIES.md Q1, Q2, Q4 and Q5 grouped by first link source
